# The player's mallet: a wooden handle from the grip (the origin) 0.9 m along +Y (away from the camera)
# to a barrel head lying across X. The game swings it about the grip. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Handle --vertices 6 --radius 0.055 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0.45 0 --rotation 90 0 0
material new Handle --base-color 0.631 0.624 0.486
material assign Handle
add mesh cylinder --name Head --vertices 8 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.46 --location 0 0.9 0 --rotation 0 90 0
material new Head --base-color 0.467 0.361 0.310
material assign Head
add mesh cylinder --name BandL --vertices 8 --radius 0.18 --depth 0.06 --location -0.17 0.9 0 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name BandR --vertices 8 --radius 0.18 --depth 0.06 --location 0.17 0.9 0 --rotation 0 90 0
material new Band --base-color 0.486 0.580 0.631
select BandL BandR
material assign Band
select all
shade flat
export mallet.glb
